widget.name: HTML viewer
widget.description: Shows HTML. Images and tables fit the width, the content never overflows, pinch zoom, and it survives network loss.

property.caption: HTML
property.description:
The HTML to show. A fragment (for example "

Hi

") or a full document. Usually an attribute: $currentObject/Body.

property.caption: Base URL
property.description: Optional. Relative image and link addresses start from this URL, for example "https://cdn.example.com/". Leave empty when all addresses are absolute.

property.caption: Extra CSS
property.description: Optional CSS added after the built-in rules, for example "h1 { font-size: 22px; }".

property.caption: Run scripts in the HTML
property.description: No (safe): script tags and onclick attributes in the HTML do not run. The viewer itself still works.

property.caption: Height
property.description: Fit content: the viewer grows with the HTML and the page scrolls (no nested scrolling). Fill parent: the viewer takes the parent height (or the style height) and scrolls inside.

property.caption: Maximum height
property.description: Fit content only. 0 = no limit. A taller content scrolls inside the viewer.

property.caption: Wide tables
property.description: Fit: the columns shrink to the screen width. Scroll: a wide table keeps readable columns and scrolls sideways in its own box. The page never scrolls sideways.

property.caption: Zoom
property.description: Fill parent: pinch to zoom in place. Fit content: pinch zoom opens in full screen, so the page scroll never fights the zoom.

property.caption: Full screen button
property.description: Show a small button that opens the content full screen. With Height = Fit content and Zoom = Yes the button always shows, because zoom happens in full screen.

property.caption: Maximum zoom
property.description: From 1 to 10.

property.caption: On link tap
property.description: The viewer never navigates away from the HTML.

enumerationValues.enumerationValue: Open in the browser or app

property.caption: Store link in
property.description: Optional. Gets the tapped address before the action runs.

property.caption: Link action
property.description: Runs when a link is tapped (On link tap = Run an action).

property.caption: On load
property.description: Runs once each time new HTML is shown.

property.caption: On error
property.description: Runs when the content cannot be shown. The widget also shows the error text and a retry button.

property.caption: Use cached images offline
property.description: Android: show images from the cache when there is no network. Broken images retry by themselves when the network comes back, when the app comes back to the front, or on tap.

property.caption: Empty text
property.description: Shown when the HTML is empty. Empty = show nothing.

property.caption: Error text
property.description: Shown when the content cannot be shown.

property.caption: Retry text
property.description: The retry button.

property.caption: Link error text
property.description: Shown when a link cannot be opened.

property.caption: Full screen label
property.description: Screen reader label of the full screen button.

property.caption: Close label
property.description: Screen reader label of the close button in full screen.
